name: samm-calc
//lodash: lodash is not imported by this app directly. react-gauge-chart@0.5.1 does require('lodash/isEqual') but omits lodash from its own dependencies; Next 10's dependency tree used to supply it transitively and Next 16's does not, so /results fails to build without it. Do not remove it as an unused dependency.
//overrides: These three chart libraries declare React peer ranges that stop at 16/17/18 and have no React 19-compatible release (react-gauge-chart@0.5.1 is its latest). None of them uses React's function-component defaultProps or any other API React 19 removed, so the incompatibility is in the declared range only. Overriding the peers (rather than setting legacy-peer-deps project-wide) keeps `npm ci` strict for every other dependency.
